questions.title: Sum of First N Natural Numbers
questions.description:
Read an integer n and print the sum of all natural numbers from 1 to n using a for loop.

Input Format:
A single integer n.

Output Format:
One line containing the sum 1 + 2 + ... + n.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 100000

questions.title: Multiplication Table
questions.description:
Read an integer n and print its multiplication table from 1 to 10, one line per row.

Input Format:
A single integer n.

Output Format:
10 lines, each in the form: n x i = product (for i from 1 to 10).

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 20

questions.title: Canteen Daily Sales Report
questions.description:
The college canteen recorded the order amount of every customer today. Given n customers and their order amounts, walk the amounts with a single for loop and produce the day's report: the total sales and the highest single order.

Input Format:
The first token is n. The next n tokens are the order amounts.

Output Format:
Line 1: Total: <sum of all amounts>
Line 2: Highest: <largest single amount>

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000, 1 <= amount <= 10000

questions.title: First N Fibonacci Numbers
questions.description:
The math club wants a poster showing the first n Fibonacci numbers, starting from 0 and 1 (0 1 1 2 3 5 ...). Print them on one line separated by single spaces. Values grow quickly, so use long arithmetic.

Input Format:
A single integer n.

Output Format:
One line with the first n Fibonacci numbers separated by single spaces.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 50

questions.title: Factorial Using while
questions.description:
Read an integer n and print n factorial (1 x 2 x ... x n) using a while loop. Note that 20! exceeds the range of int, so accumulate in a long.

Input Format:
A single integer n.

Output Format:
One line containing n!.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 20

questions.title: Count the Digits
questions.description:
Read an integer n and count how many digits it has using a while loop that divides the number by 10 repeatedly until it becomes 0.

Input Format:
A single integer n.

Output Format:
One line with the number of digits.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 2000000000

questions.title: Savings Goal with Monthly Interest
questions.description:
Aarav opens a savings account with an initial balance and deposits a fixed amount at the start of every month. At the end of each month the bank adds 2 percent interest, computed with integer math as balance = balance + balance * 2 / 100. Simulate month by month with a while loop until the balance reaches or exceeds the target, then report the number of months needed and the final balance (if the initial balance already meets the target, 0 months pass).

Input Format:
One line with three integers: initial balance, monthly deposit, and target.

Output Format:
Line 1: the number of months needed.
Line 2: the final balance.

Constraints:
1 <= initial <= 10000, 1 <= deposit <= 1000, 1 <= target <= 1000000

questions.title: Collatz Longest Chain
questions.description:
A math hobbyist studies the Collatz rule: for an even value the next value is value / 2, and for an odd value it is 3 * value + 1; every starting value eventually reaches 1. For every starting value from a to b (inclusive), count the number of steps needed to reach 1. Report the starting value with the longest chain and its step count. If several values tie, the smallest of them wins: scan from a upward and keep only strictly greater improvements.

Input Format:
One line with two integers a and b.

Output Format:
Line 1: the starting value with the most steps.
Line 2: that step count.

Constraints:
1 <= a <= b <= 10000

questions.title: Sum Until the Zero Sentinel
questions.description:
A cashier terminal accepts integers one by one until the sentinel value 0 appears; the 0 ends the session and is not counted as a sale. Read the values with a do-while loop and print the sum of all values before the sentinel.

Input Format:
A sequence of integers terminated by 0 (the final 0 ends the input).

Output Format:
One line with the sum of all values before the sentinel.

Constraints:
1 to 1000 values before the sentinel 0, each between -10000 and 10000

questions.title: Launch Countdown Timer
questions.description:
Mission control runs a launch countdown: starting from n, print one number per line down to 1, then print Liftoff!. Use a do-while loop so the countdown body always executes at least once.

Input Format:
A single integer n.

Output Format:
One line per countdown value from n down to 1, followed by the line Liftoff!.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 100
